Flag any use of exec(requests.get(...).text) patterns, decryption and execution of embedded payloads, and modifications to Windows registry Run keys. Watch for Python processes accessing browser, Discord, Telegram, and crypto wallet directories, and for outbound connections to known malicious infrastructure. Correlate file creation in non-standard locations with registry persistence and network exfiltration activity to identify multi-stage malware.
